title: Oven Roasted Portuguese Chicken Skewers
description: A light and nutty Portuguese dish featuring chicken skewers, perfect for a solo dinner, with a unique twist of Oreo cream biscuits on the side, and cooked to perfection in a tandoor-inspired oven method, low in sodium.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the lemon juice with a little water to create a glaze.
Brush the glaze over the chicken during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Serve the chicken skewers hot with Oreo cream biscuits on the side.
Drizzle any remaining glaze over the biscuits before serving.
